# Backend 开发强制规则

> 从 `.qoder/rules/backend.md` 迁移而来（Qoder `trigger: always_on` → Copilot 项目级始终生效指令）

1. Always add corresponding test cases after you make changes.
2. Always update README when you make changes.
3. Always make sure your tests are made in a temporary environment, don't infect the real db.
